item.title: How to watch New Year's Eve fireworks in Seattle
item.description: The New Year's at the Needle celebration is expected to draw big crowds on the eve of 2026. Here's how to watch and stream the display live.

item.title: Police identify mother, son as 2 killed in Mercer Island murder-suicide investigation
item.description: Police have identified a mother and son found dead during a Mercer Island welfare check as investigators continue examining four related deaths, including two discovered at a home in Issaquah.

item.title: WSDOT announces Revive I-5 work begins this January in Seattle
item.description: WSDOT is warning drivers to plan ahead for traffic as crews announce that Revive I-5 work will resume just days into the new year.

item.title: What's open, closed in Seattle on New Year's Day
item.description: Jan. 1, 2026 is New Year’s Day, a federal holiday that brings widespread closures across government services and some major businesses.

item.title: WA's Highway 2 to reopen, lifting spirits for Skykomish businesses, residents
item.description: After a nearly three-week shutdown of 50 miles of Highway 2, Gov. Bob Ferguson said that the west end of the road from Skykomish to Stevens Pass would reopen Thursday.

item.title: Skagit County, WA offers free debris disposal after record Skagit River flooding
item.description: Skagit County is offering free flood debris disposal for households affected by historic Skagit River flooding as recovery continues across the valley.

item.title: Seahawks Notebook: Injuries at tackle, Derick Hall back from suspension
item.description: It appears as though both the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers have left tackle injury concerns ahead of their NFC West title matchup on Saturday night.

item.title: Man killed in Christmas Day homicide in Mason County, WA
item.description: The suspect accused of shooting and killing his friend after a game of roughhousing on Christmas Day appeared in Mason County court Wednesday.

item.title: Torrent's Aneta Tejralová suspended two games for illegal check to head
item.description: Seattle Torrent defender Aneta Tejralová was suspended two games by the PWHL on Wednesday for an illegal check to the head of New York Sirens forward Sarah Fillier in Sunday's game in Dallas.

item.title: Seattle weather: Dense fog overnight, rain returns for New Year's Day
item.description: Showers return for new year with chances of snow by the weekend. Afternoon highs will be mild with spots in the low 50s.
